race.title: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
race.verdict: Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with multiple C&D scorer COMFORT LINE who rates the pick of the weights and is reunited with Adam Caffrey for the first time since going in at the Curragh in late summer. Desert Of The Sea wasn't seen to best effect over C&D last time and is next on the list ahead of another C&D winner, Chavajod . COMFORT LINE (IRE) DESERT OF THE SEA (IRE) CHAVAJOD
